You gain two of the following techniques, plus one more at 11th level and another at 17th level. You can use these techniques together a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses after a long rest. Once you're out of uses, you may instead spend 2 focus points to use one, though doing so lowers your focus point maximum by 2 until your next long rest.

Burning Ember Flourish. As an action, choose a flame you can see that fits within a 5-foot cube within 60 feet and snuff it out, producing either fireworks—each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded until the end of your next turn—or a 20-foot-radius cloud of heavily obscuring black smoke that bends around corners and lasts 1 minute or until dispersed by strong wind.

Curtain of Unyielding Wind. As an action, summon a howling gale in a 10-foot radius that follows you for 10 minutes. It deafens everyone within it (including you), snuffs out unprotected flames no larger than a torch, disperses vapor, gas, or fog, makes the area difficult terrain for everyone but you, and imposes disadvantage on ranged attack rolls that pass into, out of, or through it.

Crushing Hand of the Mountain. As an action, raise a Medium hand of soil and stone in an unoccupied 5-foot square you can see within 30 feet, lasting 1 minute; it reaches for one Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of it, forcing a Strength save. On a failure the target takes 2d6 kinetic damage and is restrained. As a bonus action on later turns, you can have the hand crush the restrained target, forcing another Strength save for 2d6 kinetic damage (half on a success). The restrained creature can use its action to attempt a Strength check against your focus save DC to break free. As an action, you may redirect the hand to a new creature or a new unoccupied space in range, releasing any current target.

Hatchling's Flame. As an action, unleash a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire in a direction you choose. Each creature caught in it must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 3d8 fire damage (half on a success).

Patient Bantha Listens. As a bonus action, gain tremorsense out to 30 feet and a burrow speed equal to your walking speed for up to 1 minute, leaving behind a tunnel that persists until the effect ends, then collapses.

Rush of the Shyrack. As an action, blast a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line of powerful wind from yourself for 1 minute, or until you lose concentration or dismiss it (no action required). Each Large or smaller creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength save or be pushed 15 feet along the line's direction, and any creature within it spends 2 feet of movement for every foot it tries to move closer to you. The wind disperses gas and vapor, snuffs unprotected torches and candles, and has a 50 percent chance to snuff protected flames (making them dance wildly if it doesn't). As a bonus action on later turns, you may redirect the line.

Shape the Raincloud. As an action, draw water from the air or return it there: create up to 20 gallons of drinkable water in an open container, produce rain across a 30-foot cube that extinguishes open flames, destroy an equal volume of contained water, or clear a 30-foot cube of fog.

Swarming Ice Rabbit. As an action, erupt a burst of ice from a point within 90 feet; each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered there must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 3d6 cold damage and gain 1 slowed level until the start of your next turn (half damage and no slow on a success).
